idea-plugin.name: Dead Code & Drift Radar
idea-plugin.description:
Dead Code & Drift Radar

Find code that's quietly dying. Dead Code & Drift Radar combines Git history analysis with static reference counting to assign a drift score (0–100) to every code element — showing you exactly which classes, methods, and modules are drifting toward obsolescence.

Key Features

  • Drift Scoring (0–100) — Quantified health metric for code elements based on usage and activity
  • Git History Analysis — Tracks modification frequency, last-modified dates, and contributor activity
  • Reference Counting — Static analysis of usage and call-site frequency
  • Gutter Icons — Color-coded health indicators (green/yellow/red) in the editor
  • Dashboard — Project-wide drift overview sorted by score, with trend charts
  • Configurable Thresholds — Set team standards for when code is considered drifting or dead

Why Dead Code & Drift Radar?

Dead code increases maintenance costs and cognitive load. By combining git signals with static analysis, this plugin surfaces code that other tools miss — the kind that's technically referenced but practically abandoned.

Free vs Pro

  • Free: Drift scoring, gutter icons, reference counting, basic dashboard
  • Pro: Full git history analysis, trend charts, team drift reports, CI/CD integration, auto-quarantine suggestions, and module-level dependency drift
